scope: Read-only attribution of sealed lifecycle_comparison_v1 output. No economic lifecycle run, no formula/parameter changes, no selection gates, no new prediction scores.
stock_universe: All stocks in either arm DECISIONS for each window, including those with no permission in either arm. Every permitted round is retained.
observed_subtotals: Sum evidence_usable_closed rows only. Other paths remain explicitly unknown and do not become observed zeros. An empty observed subtotal is null, not zero.
complete_stock_delta: Known only if both arms have every permission resolved as evidence-usable closed or explicit NOFILL. No permission or only explicit NOFILL is known nonparticipation zero. Any execution UNKNOWN, CENSORED, or closed financial UNKNOWN makes that stock's complete delta null; available closed subtotals may still be reported separately.
round_identity: Same event_id is paired first and must have identical normalized ACTIONS, CLAIM_LEDGER and economic outcomes, including unknown statuses. These pairs contribute zero to observed monetary differences when evidence-usable.
same_exit_pairing: After exact event pairs are removed, pair a stock and exit_day only if exactly one remaining round in each arm has that exit_day and both are evidence-usable closed. Never force repeated or ambiguous matching. Preserve all unmatched rounds and reasons.
core_decomposition: For actual initial q_C,q_R and p_C=core_net_C/q_C,p_R=core_net_R/q_R: delta_net=(q_C-q_R)*(p_C+p_R)/2 + (p_C-p_R)*(q_C+q_R)/2. This symmetric exact identity uses actual own cashflows and is not a quantity optimization, causal estimate, hypothetical entry or transplantation of another path's profits. Fees and NET80 are included in p; p need not be an invariant price spread.
gross_identity: net = raw_open_gross - slippage - fees + NET80 = after_slippage_gross - fees + NET80; CORE and FULL remain separate. FULL has additions and is not reduced to an initial-quantity/per-share identity.
mean_identity: Observed mean_C - mean_R = (S_C-S_R)*(1/N_C+1/N_R)/2 + (1/N_C-1/N_R)*(S_C+S_R)/2. Decompose delta S further by common event, unique same-exit quantity and per-share terms, unmatched available paths. Denominator component is a sample-count arithmetic term, not causal selection value.
concentration: Across every comparable complete-stock delta, sort by absolute delta descending, sid ascending tie-break. Report top 1/5/10 signed and absolute sums, shares of total absolute delta, and minimum/maximum delta after deleting any one stock. Also report an explicitly partial observed-subtotal bridge across all stocks; its signed values are not full-stock economic deltas if any path is unknown. No winner-based sample or beta grouping.
outcomes: Retain all losses, zeros, gains and UNKNOWN. Report win/loss counts and sums; near-constant average loss is not an improvement claim.
limits: Historical post-outcome descriptive attribution, not OOS or PIT certification. Independent conditional path sums are not shared-account portfolio profit/return. No executable next strategy follows without a newly frozen hypothesis and new independent evaluation.
output_restriction: Create or update only cash_* files under mechanism_attribution_v1. Source files and sealed outputs remain unchanged. Python runtime /Users/bytedance/repos/my-quant/.conda/envs/dev/bin/python, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; no installation.
